title: Source etaleness above the local section in dimension less than two
statement: Let $S$ be a normal integral Noetherian quasi-separated scheme, $c:C\to S$ a quasi-compact quasi-separated smooth morphism with geometrically connected fibres, $\sigma:S\to C$ a section, and $G$ a finite group with order invertible in $\Gamma(S,\mathcal O_S)$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let $q:C_\eta\to\operatorname{Spec}k(S)$ and $j:C_\eta\to C$ exhibit the generic fibre [def-pc-fibre-product], with a section $s_\eta$ satisfying $q s_\eta=1$ and $j s_\eta=\sigma a_\eta$. Let $Z\to C_\eta$ be a finite etale $G$-torsor with a rational point above $s_\eta$. Let $U\subset S$ contain $\eta$, let $P\to C_U$ be finite etale, and let $j_U:C_\eta\to C_U$ and $\psi:Z\to P$ exhibit its generic restriction, with $i_Uj_U=j$. Let $s\notin U$ be such that every $t\notin U$ specializing to $s$ equals $s$. Put $a:\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}\to S$, $L=C\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}$, $l:L\to C$, and let $N\to C$ be the concrete relative normalization of $P\to C_U\to C$. Let $\tau=(a\sigma,1):\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}\to L$ be the induced section. The dimension of a ring means the supremum of the lengths of strict chains of prime ideals. Assume $\dim\mathcal O_{S,s}<2$ and that $n:N\times_C L\to L$ is finite. For every point $x\in N\times_C L$ with $n(x)=\tau(\mathfrak m_{S,s})$, where $\mathfrak m_{S,s}$ is the closed point of $\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}$, there is an open source neighbourhood $V\subset N\times_C L$ of $x$ for which the composite $V\hookrightarrow N\times_C L\xrightarrow{n}L$ is etale.

proof.text: Prove the local stalk is not a field: if it were a field, its spectrum would be a singleton. The generic point of S is in the range of fromSpecStalk s since it specializes to s, while the closed point maps to s. Thus s is the generic point, contradicting hs and hηU. The dimension bound gives Krull dimension at most one; together with normality and Noetherianity it makes the stalk a Dedekind domain. The local nonfield Dedekind-domain characterization gives a DVR. This is the fully proved private Lean lemma stalk_dvr using Mathlib Stalk, KrullDimension.Basic and DiscreteValuationRing.TFAE.
Apply the tame normalization flatness statement with this DVR stalk. It uses no section and supplies Flat n on the entire local normalization.
Apply the split-section unramifiedness statement with the same DVR stalk to obtain a source open V containing x with FormallyUnramified (V.ι ≫ n).

The local total space is locally Noetherian: its base is the spectrum of a Noetherian stalk, and it is the base change of a smooth morphism. Finiteness of n gives locally finite type, hence locally finite presentation over that target. Open inclusions are flat and locally of finite presentation, so V.ι ≫ n is flat and locally of finite presentation. Apply Mathlib Etale.of_formallyUnramified_of_flat to obtain the required Etale (V.ι ≫ n).

theorem GaloisCover.stalk_normalization_trait_section_source {S C : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian S]
    [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] [IsIntegral S]
    (hS : ∀ x : S, IsIntegrallyClosed (S.presheaf.stalk x))
    (c : C ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact c] [QuasiSeparated c] [Smooth c] [GeometricallyConnected c]
    (σ : S ⟶ C) (hσ : σ ≫ c = 𝟙 S)
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G]
    (hG : IsUnit (Nat.card G : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    {Cη : Scheme.{u}} (q : Cη ⟶ Spec S.functionField) (j : Cη ⟶ C)
    (hCη : IsPullback q j (S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S)) c)
    (sη : Spec S.functionField ⟶ Cη) (hsq : sη ≫ q = 𝟙 _)
    (hsj : sη ≫ j = S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S) ≫ σ)
    (Z : GaloisCover G Cη) (hZ : ∃ z : Spec S.functionField ⟶ Z.P, z ≫ Z.π = sη)
    (U : S.Opens) (hηU : genericPoint S ∈ U)
    (jU : Cη ⟶ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme) (PA : (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.FiniteEtale)
    (ψ : Z.P ⟶ PA.obj.left) (hjU : jU ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι = j)
    (hψ : IsPullback ψ Z.π PA.obj.hom jU)
    (s : S) (hs : s ∉ U)
    (hmin : ∀ t : S, t ⤳ s → t ∉ U → t = s)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim (S.presheaf.stalk s) < (2 : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    letI : IsFinite PA.obj.hom := PA.property
    letI : QuasiCompact (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι :=
      MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (isPullback_morphismRestrict c U)
        (inferInstance : QuasiCompact U.ι)
    let a := S.fromSpecStalk s
    let n := pullback.snd (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization (pullback.fst c a)
    let τ : Spec (S.presheaf.stalk s) ⟶ pullback c a :=
      pullback.lift (a ≫ σ) (𝟙 _) (by simp [Category.assoc, hσ])
    IsFinite n → ∀ x : (pullback (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization
      (pullback.fst c a) : Scheme.{u}),
      n x = τ (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (S.presheaf.stalk s)) →
      ∃ V : (pullback (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization
        (pullback.fst c a)).Opens, x ∈ V ∧ Etale (V.ι ≫ n)
